# Adversarial upload-URL cases for the *.linear.app allowlist.
#
# Format: <accept|reject> <url>, one per line. Evaluated with loopback denied,
# so these are production semantics: an allowlist tested only against the cases
# the implementation already handles tends to pass while the interesting ones
# go unwritten, so the interesting ones are here.

# The documented uploads host and any *.linear.app subdomain, at a label
# boundary. A signed query is retained on the wire; it is only stripped in
# diagnostics.
accept https://uploads.linear.app/agent/file?sig=abc
accept https://files.linear.app/x

# Suffix look-alikes: a bare ends_with(".linear.app") or a substring match
# would admit these.
reject https://uploads.linear.app.evil.com/
reject https://evil-linear.app/
reject https://evil.com/?x=uploads.linear.app

# A userinfo form whose real host is evil.com.
reject https://uploads.linear.app@evil.com/

# A non-https scheme, and an IP literal, neither of which is *.linear.app.
reject http://uploads.linear.app/
reject https://[::1]/

# An IDN homoglyph — the "e" in "linear" is Cyrillic U+0435, so IDNA maps the
# host to a punycode label that is not "linear".
reject https://uploads.linеar.app/
